title: ChEMBL mechanism action_type controlled vocabulary
licence: ChEMBL data is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. This file lists VALUE NAMES of ChEMBL's action_type controlled vocabulary so a retrieved value can be recognised; the glosses are BioCAD's own editorial wording, not ChEMBL descriptions. Any ChEMBL-derived content cached or committed alongside it inherits the share-alike obligation and must carry this notice. Attribution: ChEMBL, EMBL-EBI.
sourceNote: The ChEMBL release documents 35 action_type values; 33 are transcribed here. A value retrieved from ChEMBL that is not in this list is reported VERBATIM and flagged as vocabulary-unrecognised - it is never dropped and never mapped onto a neighbour.
